MODEL.definition: AI model or open model family (WP1 lexicon families and other models)

INFRASTRUCTURE.definition: hardware, platform or product used to build, host or run models

MODEL_ATTRIBUTE.definition: capability, openness concept or model specification

LOCATION_OR_GROUP.definition: country, city, region or nationality group

has capability.definition: capability provided by the model, product, technology, platform or hardware

available on.definition: platform, technology or product through which the artifact is available

supported by.definition: technology, platform, product, hardware or organisation that supports the artifact

runs on.definition: hardware, platform, product or technology on which the artifact runs

used by.definition: organisation, product or person that uses or adopts the artifact

integrated into.definition: product, platform or technology into which the artifact is integrated

competes with.definition: direct competitor, rival model, organisation, product, technology, platform or hardware

outperforms.definition: the artifact is reported to perform better than another comparable artifact

licensed under.definition: license or licensing standard under which the artifact is distributed

complies with.definition: the model, organisation or artifact complies with a standard, law, license or regulation

regulated by.definition: the model, organisation or artifact is subject to a law, regulation or regulatory standard

member of family.definition: the model is a version or variant of a model family

based on.definition: the model, product, technology or platform is built on top of another model, product, technology, platform or architecture

distilled from.definition: the model was trained to imitate another model

works for.definition: the person works for, leads or holds a role in the organisation

headquartered in.definition: country, city or geographic location where the organisation is headquartered

invested in.definition: the organisation or person invested in another organisation

acquired by.definition: the model, organisation, product, technology, platform or hardware was acquired by another organisation

subsidiary of.definition: the organisation belongs to or is controlled by a parent organisation

developed by.definition: the organisation/person created or developed the model, product, technology, platform, hardware, architecture, dataset, benchmark, standard or license

founded by.definition: the organisation was founded by a person or another organisation

manufactured by.definition: organisation that manufactures or produces the hardware, product or technology

announced by.definition: the organisation/person announced the model, product, technology, platform, hardware, architecture, dataset, benchmark or standard

released by.definition: the organisation/person publicly released or published the model, product, technology, platform, hardware, dataset, benchmark, standard or license

edge_quality_tiers.A: curated WP1 lexicon model family -> developer (no article sentence)
edge_quality_tiers.B: relation passing all WP3 checks with >= 2 distinct evidence sentences (GLiREL, role-typed GLiREL, or model-name member of family); competes with needs >= 3 unless labelled TRUE in the review

graph_views.assertion: directed multigraph, one edge per evidence sentence (edge key = relation_id)
graph_views.typed: directed multigraph, one edge per unique (head, relation, tail); competes with is symmetric
graph_views.cooccurrence: undirected weighted graph of same-sentence co-mentions in >= 2 articles

edge_weight: document_count = number of distinct articles supporting the edge
date_semantics: published_at, first_seen and last_seen are article publication dates
